description: webauthn-es256 passkey owner keys (spec/KEYLOG.md §4a). assertions: VerifyAssertion(passkey(cose_hex, rp_id, origins), message, assertion, prev_counter) → want ("" = valid, returning counter). invalid_cose / invalid_records: refused by the parsers. log: records replayed in order through the state machine with signature checks; want = rejection code. ECDSA signatures are randomized: regenerate only with KEYLOG_UPDATE_VECTORS=1.

assertions.name: valid, escaped origin and extra members

second passkey (counter-less), co-signed by the first
